blocks.text: וְתֶעֱרַב עָלֶיךָ עֲתִירָתֵנוּ כְּעוֹלָה וּכְקָרְבָּן. אָנָּא רַחוּם בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים הָשֵׁב שְׁכִינָתְךָ לְצִיּוֹן וְסֵדֶר הָעֲבוֹדָה לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם. וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ שֶׁאוֹתְךָ לְבַדְּךָ בְּיִרְאָה נַעֲבוֹד:
uncertainties: לִירוּשָׁלָ͏ִם (line04): my reading disagrees with the draft. I seem to see a yod between the final lamed and the mem, with patah under the lamed, which would make it לִירוּשָׁלַיִם. I can't confirm a meteg under the shin. This is already in pending human items 445–454 (308/310 Jerusalem), so I left the text unchanged and didn't add a duplicate question.

blocks.text: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. צוּר חַיֵּינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר. נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרָיִם. הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא־תַמּוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּינוּ לָךְ:
uncertainties: Line09, right column: וֵאלֹהֵי, and likely אֱלֹהֵינוּ too, is printed with the aleph-lamed ligature (ﭏ). Written out as separate letters.
לְּךָ (line12): I couldn't confirm the dagesh in the lamed at this resolution.
The maqaf in שֶׁבְּכָל־ is printed at the end of line15 and confirmed.

blocks.text: מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵי כָל בָּשָׂר יוֹצְרֵנוּ יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּנוּ כֵּן תְּחַיֵּנוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵנוּ וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצֹנֶךָ וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם עַל שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ. בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת:

גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ (line12): the qubuts and dagesh are faint.

blocks.text: וְעַל כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל־בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶךָ: וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת־שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

הָאֵל (line20) seems to be printed with the aleph-lamed ligature (ﭏ). Written out as separate letters.

blocks.text: While the Kohanim make their way to the דוכן, the congregation say: ותערב

May our entreaty be pleasing to Thee like the whole-offering and the sacrifice. O Merciful One, restore Thy presence to Zion in Thy great mercies and the order of worship to Jerusalem. Let our eyes behold Thy return to Zion in compassion and let us serve Thee there in awe as in olden times and former years. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, whom alone we wish to worship in awe.
uncertainties: 'whole-offering' is broken at a line end but is a real compound word. 'pres-ence' is a line-break hyphen and was joined.
'Blessed art Thou…' starts a new paragraph after the cue word ברוך.

blocks.text: We thank Thee for Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers for ever and ever. The Rock of our life, the Shield of our salvation art Thou from generation to generation. We thank Thee and tell of Thy fame for our life that is delivered in Thy hand for our souls that are entrusted to Thee and for Thy miracles that are daily with us and for Thy wonders and benefits at all times, evening, morning and noon. O Thou who art good for Thy mercies never end, O Thou who showest mercy for Thy sindnesses never cease, ever have we trusted in Thee.
uncertainties: 'sindnesses' is kept as printed. See source_sic_corr.

blocks.text: We thank Thee because Thou art the Lord our God and the God of our fathers, the God of all flesh, our Creator, the Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanks to Thy Great and Holy Name for having kept us alive and let us survive. So mayest Thou further keep us alive and let us survive and gather our exiles to the court-yards of Thy Sanctuary in order to observe Thy statutes and do Thy will and serve Thee whole-heartedly; wherefore we thank Thee. Blessed be God to whom thanks are due.
uncertainties: 'Cre-ator', 'may-est' and 'Bless-ed' are line-break hyphens and were joined. 'court-yards' and 'whole-heartedly' fall mid-line, so their hyphens are real.

blocks.text: For all of them may Thy Name, O our King, be continually blessed and exalted for ever and ever. And inscribe for a good life all the children of Thy Covenant. And all the living thank Thee, Selah, and praise Thy Name in truth, O God of our salvation and of our aid, Selah! Blessed art Thou, O Lord, All-benevolent, whose name is goodness and unto whom it is becoming to give thanks.

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing that is written in the Torah through Moses Thy servant and was uttered by the mouth of Aaron and his sons the priests, Thy holy people, as it is said:

verdict: NOT APPROVED. Partial result: all 13 images were read and none were unreadable. Every Hebrew word on lines 01–24 was compared against the image, but several dagesh and holam marks can't be resolved at this resolution (listed in human_questions), so the Hebrew check is not complete. One spelling patch is proposed (רְצוֹנֶךָ → רְצֹנֶךָ). The English on s311 matches the draft exactly, including punctuation, except the printed misspelling 'sindnesses' (in source_sic_corr). Two role labels were already listed in the draft's notes but were missing from role_labels, and the 'Congregation:' label was missing entirely; all three are now listed. My Jerusalem reading on line04 seems to show a yod, which disagrees with the draft's CGJ spelling. It's left for the pending human items 445–454. The s310 header isn't in any line pack, so it wasn't checked against an image. s310 has no Bible text or cantillation, and Num 10:10 is on s308, outside this pair.
